verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a first-party `session_id` integer parameter that routes multiple API requests through the same IP address. That directly delivers sticky-IP sessions for a consistent identity. The evidence is a single parameter-table line, though, so depth is thin. missing for 10: documented session lifetime/expiry and limits, details on how sessions interact with premium/stealth proxies, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route multiple requests through the same proxy IP using a session identifier to maintain a consistent identity

citations.quote: session_id [integer] ("") Route multiple API requests through the same IP address
